centre.prefere_libelle: Emotional (cut off in order to function)
centre.reprime_invitation: Today, the center you are working with is the deep Emotional: feeling what is, not what presents well. Stop functioning for a few minutes — in order to exist.

dynamique_ego.passion_explication: A functional vanity, almost invisible: 'I am what I do, what I project, what I achieve.' The image fits so well that it gets mistaken for the self.
dynamique_ego.peur_de_base: Being worthless apart from what one does.
dynamique_ego.desir_de_base: Having worth, being validated, being someone.

essence.qualite_phrase: You are of worth before having proven it — you are before you do.
horizons: Feeling what is, behind what shows
Recognizing the image as image — without hating it, without clinging to it
Touching the worth that depends on no achievement

intentions_du_matin: Do something that will not be seen
Slow down — truly, not as a performance of slowness
Feel what is, without optimizing it
Accept being ordinary for an hour
Honor an emotion without turning it into action
Receive a compliment without bouncing to the next one
Fail at one small thing without hiding it
Be present without having to shine
pratiques_du_matin: Before noon, produce nothing for 15 minutes. Just sit.
When someone asks 'how are you?', give the true answer, not the social one.
Drink a tea with no phone, no podcast, nothing to 'extract' from the moment.
Feel a bodily signal (fatigue, hunger, tension) instead of pushing through it.
Check off nothing on today's to-do list — see what happens.
Cancel something that isn't essential. Liberation is the practice.

zones.description: Presence before performance. You touch your intrinsic worth. What you do serves the soul, not the image. Authenticity is savored as a gift.
You function, you perform — but you feel when the image is taking up too much room. You can slow down.
The image drives. You run. You compare. Fatigue is denied. Feeling becomes a cost you can't afford.
Burnout, dissociation, inner emptiness behind the impeccable facade. A very heavy day that calls for a true stop, not a photogenic pause.

details_riso.texte: Authentic, accepting, without a facade. You are yourself, in success as in failure. Worth lies in being.
Self-assured, accomplished, confident. You perform out of vocation, not to fill a void.
Adaptable, ambitious, inspiring. You embody what you represent.
Competitive, image-conscious. You compare. You calibrate your appearance.
Calculating, narcissistic. The image takes up all the room. Feeling drifts away.
Arrogant, hostile, expedient. You see others as obstacles or resources.
Deceitful, manipulative, false. You lie to yourself first.
Vengeful, sabotaging others' success, inner emptiness.
Collapse, relational psychopathy. Asking for help is vital here.

passions.label: I did too much, too fast
passions.detail: Doing in order not to feel.

passions.label: I weighed myself by what I had produced
I converted an emotion into action
passions.detail: So as not to feel it.

pieges.label: I answered quickly to show I was present
I put on a social face to hide my real state
I lived my life as something to narrate
pieges.detail: More than as something to live.

pieges.label: I bounced off a compliment toward the next one

moments.label: I did nothing — and it was enough
I felt my fatigue and honored it
I felt worthy without producing anything
I failed and it was human
I was present without having to shine
The ordinary felt good to me
I touched who I am, beneath what I do

evenements_a_relire.label: I let a failure be seen
I felt my worth independent of doing

remedes.label: Feeling — what is, not what shows
The pearl — who I am beneath the image
Honored failure — which makes one human

matin: The morning begins. What do you want to *be*, more than do?
A day opens — what could simply remain undone?
What do you want to feel, behind what will present itself?
midi: You are in the middle of the day. Have you felt your body?
Here you are. What did you truly do — for yourself?
A possible pause. Set it down, truly.
soir: The day is fading. What can be left unfinished?
You can simply arrive, without bringing back anything to report.
The evening is gentle. One true thing is just fine.
nuit: The night watches. One true word, then sleep.
You are still here, without having to prove it.
